topic: Chatting with a taxi driver on the way home
topic_cn: 回家路上和出租司机聊天
passage: Last Thursday, I finished work at seven and looked for a taxi at the gate. It was raining hard, so I pulled up my hood and waited. After five minutes, a green taxi slowed down and picked me up. I got in, sat down, and told the driver my street name. He turned on the radio, then turned it down so we could talk. He asked if I worked nearby, and I pointed out the office building behind us. I found out that he had driven taxis here for fifteen years. While we waited at a red light, he brought up the old bus station that had been torn down. I wrote down the street name he mentioned. The traffic cleared up, and he sped up along the river. He dropped me off at my building and handed me a card. I put it away, paid the fare, and thanked him. Before he drove off, he smiled and said I could call him next time. I walked in, took off my wet coat, and made a cup of tea. The short chat cheered me up after a long day.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录，主弱项继续是过去式 -ed 听辨和短语动词连读，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「回家路上和出租司机聊天」是全新的闲聊话题，短文里有 finished/looked/pulled/waited/slowed/picked/turned/asked/pointed/mentioned/cleared/dropped/handed/thanked/smiled/walked/cheered 等规则过去式；looked for、pulled up、slowed down、picked up、got in、sat down、turned on、turned down、pointed out、found out、brought up、torn down、wrote down、cleared up、sped up、dropped off、put away、drove off、walked in、took off、cheered up 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
